metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: HTML rendering, session naming, and workflow helpers.

plugins.name: to-html
plugins.description: HTML rendering mode for Claude Code. Toggle with /to-html; every assistant response is also written to a self-contained HTML artifact. Native plan-mode integration: ExitPlanMode plans auto-render with phase sidebar, status badges, and live reload as tasks progress. Includes interactive controls (sliders, dropdowns, kanban, choice) and copy-as-prompt export. Strict CSP, deterministic renderer.

plugins.name: sesh
plugins.description: Auto-names Claude Code sessions based on conversation context. Silent UserPromptSubmit hook that injects a one-time naming instruction after a few user messages.
